controls.keyboardHint: Sensitivity and the Y axis affect the in-game camera; FOV and the halftone pattern are visible instantly in the diorama and in the game.
controls.gamepadConnectHint: Connect a gamepad (DualShock 4 via USB or Bluetooth, or any generic controller) and press any button so the browser detects it.
controls.w3cMappingNote: Standard W3C mapping: 0=Cross (A), 1=Circle (B), 2=Square (X), 3=Triangle (Y), 4=L1, 5=R1, 6=L2, 7=R2, 9=Options (Start), 12..15=D-Pad. The left stick moves Nyx (analog WASD), the right stick rotates the camera and the gamepad works without capturing the mouse. Options opens/closes the pause menu and Circle (B) also closes it.

tutorials.title: TUTORIALS
tutorials.subtitle: One mechanic per level · 5 playable lessons

tutorial_de_movimiento.title: MOVEMENT
tutorial_de_movimiento.paragraph1: Move with WASD in a frenetic zero-G arena where you can reach extreme speeds, and brake using SPACE.
tutorial_de_movimiento.paragraph2: Execute dashes in any direction with RIGHT CLICK, attack with LEFT CLICK (or Void Fall with no target), and trigger equipped skills with 1, 2, and 3.

tutorial_de_rebotes.title: KINETIC BOUNCE
tutorial_de_rebotes.paragraph1: When you're moving fast enough and aim at a floating slab or its iceberg, the reticle turns blue.
tutorial_de_rebotes.paragraph2: Press RIGHT CLICK to bounce off the surface and chain momentum, letting you gain massive speed.

tutorial_de_slow_mo.title: SLOW-MO
tutorial_de_slow_mo.paragraph1: In the game, certain attacks, parries, dodges, or special moves activate slow-mo mode.
tutorial_de_slow_mo.paragraph2: Use this dilated time window to redirect your trajectory with a dash or line up your next strike.

tutorial_de_habilidades.title: SKILLS & VISUAL STATES
tutorial_de_habilidades.stateReady: READY · Full cyan/violet ring & bright icon: press 1/2/3 when you have enough Eden.
tutorial_de_habilidades.stateActive: ACTIVE · Bright electric-cyan ring: skill currently active (e.g. rocks waiting for Left Click throw).
tutorial_de_habilidades.stateCooldown: COOLDOWN · Dim icon at 42% with shrinking clockwise arc & timer.
tutorial_de_habilidades.stateEmpty: EMPTY · Dimmed slot until unlocked on level-up.
tutorial_de_habilidades.s1: Gravity Field: orbits rocks to fire (Left Click). Extra: grabs slab debris, Octopus Ink Balls (90 dmg) & Butterfly Electric Balls (140 dmg unbreakable magnet).
tutorial_de_habilidades.s2: Repulse Push: radial knockback blast. Extra: instant KO slamming foes into the White Barrier & reflects Electric Balls.
tutorial_de_habilidades.s3: Eden Absorb: slow below 3.55 m/s to restore Health & Eden instantly (0 Eden).
tutorial_de_habilidades.s4: Attraction Well: slams 2 foes together. Extra: against a single foe, crushes them between the 2 nearest slabs.
tutorial_de_habilidades.s5: Bounce Horizon: fires piercing crescent slashes. Extra: gains auto-aim from Lv 2 onward.
tutorial_de_habilidades.s6: Black Hole: drifting suction vortex dealing AoE damage for 4.5 s.
tutorial_de_habilidades.s7: Implosion (Legendary): instakills basics, deals -20% max HP to elites, or breaks 1 KRONOS Dorsal Star (Phases 2 & 3 only).
tutorial_de_habilidades.paragraph1: Press 1, 2, or 3 to cast the skill in that slot. Many interact directly with slabs and enemy projectiles.
tutorial_de_habilidades.paragraph2: Watch the ring glow and icon brightness under your Yin-Yang bar to read ready, active, or cooldown states at a glance.

mobile.title: PC ONLY
mobile.body: OUTORBIT is a spherical gravity experience designed exclusively for Keyboard + Mouse (Pointer Lock, WASD, Gravity Shift with right click).
mobile.footer: Open the game from a desktop computer to pilot the squad.

skillDescriptions.gravityField: Traps up to 2 pieces of debris in stasis and orbits them in front of Nyx; press again to fling them at an enemy. Each level catches more and larger objects and launches them with far greater force.
skillDescriptions.push: Antigravitational wave from both palms that blasts enemies within range away (and pushes floating slabs if not grounded). An enemy knocked into the White Barrier is eliminated instantly. Each level expands radius and knockback.
skillDescriptions.edenAbsorption: Channel by standing completely still with arms raised to instantly recover Health and Eden with an ascending halo. Each level increases the recovery amount.
skillDescriptions.attractionWell: Tethers two nearby enemies (or two slabs with an enemy caught between) with intense gravitational pull for 1.8 s; upon collision they suffer impact damage and are stunned. Each level increases range and crush damage.
skillDescriptions.bounceHorizon: Unleashes slashing waves that cleave space and pierce enemies in their path. Each level unleashes more waves, gaining auto-aim toward locked targets from Lv 2 onward.
skillDescriptions.blackHole: Fires a miniature accretion-disk singularity that drifts slowly through the dome for 4.5 s, pulling in and tearing apart everything caught in its event horizon. Each level expands suction radius and damage.
skillDescriptions.implosion: Compresses the internal gravity of a target enemy until it collapses in on itself and vanishes instantly (shatters a crystal/segment on bosses). Legendary skill with no upgrade levels.
skillDescriptions.speed1: Fly 20% faster than base; physics dictates that kicks hit harder and penetrate deeper.
skillDescriptions.speed2: Fly 50% faster: kicks strike with immense force and entering Spiral Drill Kick becomes effortless.
skillDescriptions.speed3: Fly 75% faster: maximum force and penetration on every gravitational impact.
skillDescriptions.edenRegen1: Regenerates 2% of your Eden bar per second, only while standing completely still.
skillDescriptions.edenRegen2: Regenerates 3% of Eden per second while floating motionless or standing still.
skillDescriptions.edenRegen3: Regenerates 5% of Eden per second as soon as you come to a stop.
skillDescriptions.hpRegen1: Passively and steadily regenerates 1.5% of max Health per second, even while moving or fighting.
skillDescriptions.hpRegen2: Regenerates 2% of max Health per second continuously at all times.
skillDescriptions.hpRegen3: Regenerates 3% of max Health per second continuously. Vastly improves combat survival.
